detailed_descriptions.en: Tie down means to physically secure an object so it cannot move - and in this business, everything needs to stay put. After living life on top of the world, a series of bad choices leaves you with nothing. Left to pickup the pieces, you purchase a questionably sourced phone from a fellow homeless man, and begin rebuilding your life by delivering packages across the island of Westlake Bay for the Greystone Corporation. Accept procedurally generated jobs and deliver packages of all shapes, sizes, and weights across the island. Grab, load, and secure everything using physics based interactions. Explore the open world of Westlake Bay and discover distinct towns, hidden locations, and eccentric people with stories and problems of their own. Keep your vehicle fuelled, yourself fed, and your cargo off the highway. Browse a diverse marketplace for procedurally customized cars, trucks and trailers. Meet in person with sellers, expand your fleet, and find increasingly questionable ways to carry larger loads. Build trust with Greystone to unlock more valuable packages, longer routes, and better paying contracts. Bigger jobs demand better equipment and a little more creativity. Build your delivery business alone or with friends in online co-op. Thank you so much for checking out my game. I am a solo developer that is very passionate about the games I make and couldn't do it without the support of the people closest to me. I will continue to strive towards a player first experience as I develop into the future. I welcome any and all feedback, and hope you have fun playing! ~ Rotary Interactive

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Tie down means to physically secure an object so it cannot move - and in this business, everything needs to stay put.

After living life on top of the world, a series of bad choices leaves you with nothing. Left to pickup the pieces, you purchase a questionably sourced phone from a fellow homeless man, and begin rebuilding your life by delivering packages across the island of Westlake Bay for the Greystone Corporation.

      Accept procedurally generated jobs and deliver packages of all shapes, sizes, and weights across the island.

      Grab, load, and secure everything using physics based interactions.

      Explore the open world of Westlake Bay and discover distinct towns, hidden locations, and eccentric people with stories and problems of their own. Keep your vehicle fuelled, yourself fed, and your cargo off the highway.

      Browse a diverse marketplace for procedurally customized cars, trucks and trailers. Meet in person with sellers, expand your fleet, and find increasingly questionable ways to carry larger loads.

      Build trust with Greystone to unlock more valuable packages, longer routes, and better paying contracts. Bigger jobs demand better equipment and a little more creativity.

      Build your delivery business alone or with friends in online co-op.



Thank you so much for checking out my game. I am a solo developer that is very passionate about the games I make and couldn't do it without the support of the people closest to me. I will continue to strive towards a player first experience as I develop into the future. I welcome any and all feedback, and hope you have fun playing! 

~ Rotary Interactive
